ETS‑Lindgren Showcases HEMP/IEMI Solutions at 2026 International Conference of Doble Clients
 March 23, 2026
CEDAR PARK, Texas – March 23, 2026 – ETS‑Lindgren, the Test and Measurement Solutions global leader, will share the latest in High-Altitude Electromagnetic Pulse (HEMP), Electromagnetic Pulse (EMP), and Intentional Electromagnetic Interference (IEMI) Solutions during the 2026 International Conference of Doble Clients (ICODC). The Conference, organized by the Doble Engineering Company, will be held from March 29 to April 3, 2026, in Boston at the Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport. Designed for utility and power system professionals, engineers, and industry stakeholders, the Conference emphasizes electrical testing, diagnostics, asset management, and reliability of critical power infrastructure while fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing among attendees.
National security infrastructure must withstand extreme electromagnetic events. ETS‑Lindgren delivers hardened facilities and validation systems to protect defense electronics from HEMP, EMP, and IEMI threats. Engineered to safeguard critical infrastructure from these potentially damaging electromagnetic events, our Solutions are crafted to prevent operational disruption and damage.
“We are excited to exhibit at ICODC,” enthused Bob Piemonte, Director of Government/General Purpose Shielding with ETS‑Lindgren. “This long-standing industry tradition is a premier platform for connecting with over 1,300 power professionals, including key utility engineers and executives who specify grid diagnostic solutions. Join us to discuss the latest advancements in asset reliability utilizing ETS‑Lindgren’s EMP Hardened Solutions and Powerline Filters. We will have our EMP Hardened 13U Rack Enclosure and an example of our EMP Powerline Filters on display in our exhibit space, so please visit our booth.”
Stop by ETS‑Lindgren’s Booth 403 to see one of our HEMP Filters in person and to visit with our Global Experts about our innovative and cost-effective HEMP/IEMI Solutions. For greater insight into today’s dynamic HEMP/IEMI industry, review our Solutions for EMP and Test and Measurement Solutions Full Line Brochures. Read our Public Utility Case Study, providing an educational overview of a real-world EMP Solution of a public utility’s operational computer systems, which are to particularly vulnerable to a destructive HEMP/IEMI attack.
Attend the 2026 ICODC Exhibition on Tuesday, March 31, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm; Wednesday, April 1, from 12:00 to 1:30 pm and from 5:30 to 7:00 pm; as well as Thursday, April 2, from 12:00 to 1:30 pm (all times are EDT). “I look forward to meeting attendees at ICODC,” said Tara Kellogg, Global Director, Business Development, with ETS‑Lindgren. “This Conference brings together global experts in the HEMP, EMP, and IEMI communities for six days of technical presentations and a very interactive Exhibition. We are proud to share our innovative customized and standard solutions as well as learn about emerging requirements. These fruitful discussions with industry experts help our engineering team create our next generation of HEMP, EMP, and IEMI Solutions.”
To learn more about the 2026 International Conference of Doble Clients, click here. If you are unable to visit with our sales professionals in person at the Conference, contact us online or call +1 512.531.6400 USA or +358.2.8383.300 Europe.
About ETS‑Lindgren
ETS‑Lindgren is an international manufacturer of components and systems that measure, shield, and control electromagnetic energy. The company’s products are used for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), microwave, wireless, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) testing, electromagnetic field (EMF) measurement, and radio frequency (RF) personal safety monitoring.
Headquartered in Cedar Park, Texas, ETS‑Lindgren has manufacturing facilities in North America, Europe, and Asia. The company is a wholly owned subsidiary of ESCO Technologies, a leading supplier of engineered products for growing industrial and commercial markets. ESCO is a New York Stock Exchange listed company (symbol ESE) with headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Additional information about ETS‑Lindgren is available at www.ets-lindgren.com. Follow ETS‑Lindgren on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube. Additional information about ESCO and its subsidiaries is available at www.escotechnologies.com.

 Near-Field to Far-Field 
Near-field antenna measurements are transformed into highly accurate far-field performance data. ETS‑Lindgren scanners enable precise characterization of radiation patterns, gain, and efficiency.
At ETS‑Lindgren, our Near-Field to Far-Field (NF-FF) transformation capabilities provide accurate and efficient antenna characterization without requiring large far-field test ranges. Our NF-FF solutions allow for precise near-field data acquisition, which is then mathematically transformed into far-field results, enabling detailed analysis of antenna performance while minimizing space and environmental constraints.
We support various near-field measurement techniques, including planar, cylindrical, and spherical scanning, to accommodate different antenna types and applications. These methodologies ensure accurate characterization of key parameters such as gain, beamwidth, polarization, and radiation patterns. By leveraging advanced probe positioning systems, high-precision RF measurement instrumentation, and sophisticated transformation algorithms, we provide reliable far-field data with excellent accuracy and repeatability.
ETS‑Lindgren’s NF-FF solutions are ideal for industries requiring high-performance antenna testing, including aerospace, defense, and wireless communications. Our systems integrate seamlessly with our comprehensive test and measurement solutions, offering automated data processing and real-time visualization tools. With our expertise in electromagnetic measurement and system integration, we deliver turnkey NF-FF solutions that help engineers optimize antenna designs and meet stringent industry standards.

 Near-field Scanners 
High-resolution ETS‑Lindgren near-field scanners capture detailed electromagnetic behavior of antennas and devices. They provide fast, repeatable data for design, diagnostics, and OTA validation.
At ETS‑Lindgren, our near-field scanner solutions provide precise and efficient antenna characterization for a variety of applications, including aerospace, defense, wireless communications, and research. Our near-field measurement systems are designed to accurately assess antenna performance by capturing electromagnetic field data at close proximity before transforming it into far-field results. This approach enables high-resolution measurements while reducing the space and environmental constraints associated with traditional far-field testing.
Our near-field scanners support multiple scanning methodologies, including planar, cylindrical, and spherical scanning, to accommodate different antenna types and test requirements. With advanced positioning systems, RF measurement instrumentation, and automation software, we ensure highly accurate and repeatable data collection. Our solutions are capable of measuring gain, phase, polarization, beamwidth, and radiation patterns, providing comprehensive insight into antenna performance.
By leveraging our expertise in electromagnetic testing and system integration, ETS‑Lindgren delivers turnkey near-field measurement solutions that enhance testing efficiency and accuracy. Our systems are designed for ease of use, featuring automated processes and seamless data analysis tools to help engineers and researchers optimize antenna designs and meet stringent industry standards.

 Antenna Radiated Pattern Measurements 
ETS‑Lindgren delivers turnkey antenna measurement systems for characterizing gain, polarization, and radiation patterns. Chambers, positioners, probes, and software provide lab-grade RF performance insight.
At ETS‑Lindgren, our Antenna Radiated Pattern Measurement capabilities provide precise characterization of antenna performance across a wide range of frequencies and applications. We offer industry-leading solutions for measuring key antenna parameters, including radiation patterns, gain, directivity, polarization, and beamwidth. Our state-of-the-art measurement systems ensure accurate and repeatable results, enabling customers to evaluate and optimize antenna designs for various industries, including aerospace, defense, telecommunications, and automotive.
Our test solutions include fully anechoic chambers, compact ranges, and outdoor test ranges designed to minimize interference and reflections, ensuring high-fidelity measurements. We support a variety of measurement techniques, such as far-field, near-field, and compact range testing, allowing flexibility based on customer requirements and facility constraints. Additionally, our advanced positioning systems provide precise control over antenna movement, enabling comprehensive 3D radiation pattern characterization.
ETS‑Lindgren’s radiated pattern measurement systems are fully integrated with industry-leading software for automated data acquisition, analysis, and reporting. Our expertise in RF measurement and system integration ensures that our customers receive turnkey solutions tailored to their specific needs. Whether for research, production testing, or regulatory compliance, our antenna measurement solutions provide the accuracy and reliability required for today’s demanding applications.

 Security 
ETS‑Lindgren delivers advanced, customizable shielding solutions that protect secure environments—such as SCIFs, HEMP/EMP/IEMI facilities, Cold Storage, and TEMPEST applications—from electromagnetic threats, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and operational reliability of critical assets and communications.
At ETS‑Lindgren, we offer a full spectrum of shielding solutions tailored to meet the security needs of various applications, including SCIFs (Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities), HEMP, EMP, IEMI, Cold Storage, Secure Conference Rooms, and TEMPEST environments. Our advanced shielding technologies are designed to protect sensitive information and critical assets from a range of electromagnetic threats. For SCIFs, we provide comprehensive shielding to ensure the confidentiality of communications and data by blocking external electromagnetic signals. Similarly, our HEMP, EMP, and IEMI solutions are specifically designed to protect high-security areas from disruptive electromagnetic events that could otherwise compromise security and operational integrity.
In addition to these high-level protections, we also offer specialized shielding for Cold Storage and Secure Conference Rooms, ensuring that these critical environments remain secure and free from unauthorized electronic surveillance or interference. Our solutions for TEMPEST applications provide a heightened level of shielding, ensuring that electronic emissions from within sensitive facilities do not radiate outside, maintaining the security of classified information. These shielding systems are essential for organizations that require the utmost protection for both their physical assets and the data they manage.
Through our range of customizable solutions, ETS‑Lindgren ensures that security applications are fortified against electromagnetic threats, safeguarding not only the confidentiality of communications but also the operational reliability of facilities. Whether it’s ensuring secure environments for classified meetings, protecting sensitive data from external disturbances, or maintaining the integrity of critical infrastructures, our shielding technologies are designed to provide peace of mind and resilient protection for your most vital assets.
